```{r setup}
library(conflicted)
library(tidyverse)
library(powerjoin)
library(here)
library(synExtra)
library(DESeq2)
library(readxl)
library(ggrastr)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(RUVSeq)
library(plotly)

conflicts_prefer(
  dplyr::filter,
  dplyr::count,
  generics::setdiff,
  dplyr::slice,
  dplyr::rename,
  purrr::reduce,
  DESeq2::counts
)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica")
)

synapser::synLogin()
syn <- synDownloader(normalizePath("~/data"), .cache = TRUE)

plot_dir <- here(
  "2026-07-07_coralie_ngfr_rnaseq", "plots"
)
dir.create(
  plot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE
)
```

## Loading data

Sample numbers restart in each sequencing run, so samples are identified by
`sample_uid` = `<sequencing_batch>_<Sample>`.

```{r load-data}
counts_raw <- c(
  "batch_1" = "syn76375618",
  "batch_2" = "syn77628475"
) |>
  map(\(x) read_tsv(syn(x)))

gene_meta <- counts_raw |>
  map(\(x) distinct(x, gene_id, gene_name, gene_biotype)) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  distinct()

meta_raw <- c(
  batch_1 = "syn76375613",
  batch_2 = "syn77628478"
) |>
  map(
    \(x) read_excel(
      syn(x),
      sheet = "Priority",
      skip = 1
    )
  ) |>
  bind_rows(.id = "sequencing_batch") |>
  rename(
    library_prep_batch = Batch
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(library_prep_batch, \(x) replace_na(x, 1)),
    NGFRstatus = case_when(
      Group == "Acute" ~ "unsorted",
      NGFRstatus == "NGFR+" ~ "NGFRpos",
      NGFRstatus == "NGFR-" ~ "NGFRneg",
      TRUE ~ NA
    ),
    condition = paste(
      Cell_line, Group, NGFRstatus, Treatment, paste0("d", Timepoint),
      sep = "_"
    ),
    sample_uid = paste(sequencing_batch, Sample, sep = "_")
  )
```

Some library prep batch 1 samples were sequenced again in batch 2
(`Sample_batch1` gives the sample number in batch 1). These technical
replicate pairs are used by RUVs to estimate the sequencing batch effect.

```{r technical-replicates}
reseq_pairs <- meta_raw |>
  filter(sequencing_batch == "batch_2", !is.na(Sample_batch1)) |>
  transmute(
    pair_id = paste0("pair_", Sample_batch1),
    batch_1 = paste("batch_1", Sample_batch1, sep = "_"),
    batch_2 = sample_uid
  )

reseq_pairs
```

```{r count-matrix}
counts_long <- counts_raw |>
  map(
    \(x) x |>
      select(gene_id, ends_with("_count")) |>
      pivot_longer(
        -gene_id,
        names_to = c("library_id", "sample_id"),
        names_pattern = "^([^_]+)_([0-9]+)_count$",
        values_to = "count"
      )
  ) |>
  bind_rows(.id = "sequencing_batch") |>
  mutate(
    sample_uid = paste(sequencing_batch, sample_id, sep = "_")
  )

count_mat <- counts_long |>
  select(gene_id, sample_uid, count) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_uid,
    values_from = count,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  column_to_rownames("gene_id") |>
  as.matrix()

genes_eligible <- rownames(count_mat)[rowSums(count_mat > 3) > 3] |>
  str_subset("^ENSG")
```

## Prepare sample metadata and normalization

```{r prepare-normalization}
deseq_meta <- meta_raw |>
  filter(sample_uid %in% colnames(count_mat)) |>
  left_join(
    reseq_pairs |>
      pivot_longer(
        c(batch_1, batch_2),
        names_to = NULL, values_to = "sample_uid"
      ),
    by = "sample_uid"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    merged_id = coalesce(pair_id, sample_uid)
  )

deseq_norm <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_mat[genes_eligible, deseq_meta$sample_uid] |>
    round(),
  colData = deseq_meta |>
    column_to_rownames("sample_uid"),
  design = ~ 1
) |>
  estimateSizeFactors() |>
  estimateDispersions()
```

## RUVs batch correction

RUVs estimates the unwanted variation factor `W_1` from the differences within
each technical replicate pair (same library, two sequencing runs). All genes are
used as negative controls (seems ok based on RUVseq vignette)

```{r estimate-ruv}
ruv_input <- counts(deseq_norm, normalized = TRUE) |>
  round()

# Each row is one replicate set, columns are column indices into ruv_input
ruv_sc_idx <- reseq_pairs |>
  select(batch_1, batch_2) |>
  as.matrix() |>
  apply(2, \(x) match(x, colnames(ruv_input)))

stopifnot(!anyNA(ruv_sc_idx))

ruv_res <- RUVs(
  ruv_input,
  cIdx = rownames(ruv_input),
  k = 1,
  scIdx = ruv_sc_idx,
  isLog = FALSE
)

deseq_norm$W_1 <- ruv_res$W[, "W_1"]
deseq_meta$W_1 <- ruv_res$W[, "W_1"]
deseq_meta$size_factor <- sizeFactors(deseq_norm)[deseq_meta$sample_uid]

write_csv(
  deseq_meta,
  file.path(plot_dir, "sample_metadata_with_ruv_w1_and_size_factors.csv")
)
```

`W_1` should mainly separate the two sequencing runs.

```{r plot-ruv}
p <- deseq_meta |>
  ggplot(
    aes(x = fct_reorder(sample_uid, W_1), y = W_1, color = sequencing_batch)
  ) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(
    aes(group = pair_id),
    data = \(df) filter(df, !is.na(pair_id)),
    color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5))
p

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "ruv_w1.pdf"),
  p, width = 8, height = 4
)
```

```{r transform-counts}
vst_raw <- vst(deseq_norm, blind = TRUE) |>
  assay()

# Protect the biological signal while regressing out W_1
vst_ruv <- limma::removeBatchEffect(
  vst_raw,
  covariates = deseq_meta$W_1,
  design = model.matrix(~ condition, data = deseq_meta)
)
```

## PCA

```{r compute-pca}
pca_condition_colors <- c(
  "Acute | unsorted | DMSO" = "#c8c5c5",
  "Acute | unsorted | Vemurafenib" = "#444444",
  "SingleClone | NGFRneg | Vemurafenib" = "#9ECAE1",
  "SingleClone | NGFRpos | Vemurafenib" = "#2171B5",
  "FACS | NGFRneg | Vemurafenib" = "#FCAE91",
  "FACS | NGFRpos | Vemurafenib" = "#CB181D",
  "FACS | NGFRneg | IFNg" = "#93ead4",
  "FACS | NGFRpos | IFNg" = "#1b9173",
  "FACS | NGFRneg | TNFa" = "#f7e8b6",
  "FACS | NGFRpos | TNFa" = "#f0be19",
  "FACS | NGFRneg | DMSO" = "#f5a2f1",
  "FACS | NGFRpos | DMSO" = "#ef38e6"
)

pca_meta <- deseq_meta |>
  mutate(
    across(
      Group,
      \(x) factor(x, levels = c("Acute", "SingleClone", "FACS"))
    ),
    across(
      NGFRstatus,
      \(x) factor(x, levels = c("unsorted", "NGFRneg", "NGFRpos"))
    ),
    Treatment_short = str_remove(Treatment, "_[0-9]+$"),
    condition_pca = paste(
      Group, NGFRstatus, Treatment_short, sep = " | "
    ) |>
      factor(levels = names(pca_condition_colors)),
    cell_line_batch = paste(Cell_line, sequencing_batch, sep = " | ")
  )

# Shape encodes cell line, filled = batch_1, hollow = batch_2
pca_cell_lines <- sort(unique(pca_meta$Cell_line))
pca_shape_values <- c(
  set_names(
    c(16, 17, 15, 18)[seq_along(pca_cell_lines)],
    paste(pca_cell_lines, "batch_1", sep = " | ")
  ),
  set_names(
    c(1, 2, 0, 5)[seq_along(pca_cell_lines)],
    paste(pca_cell_lines, "batch_2", sep = " | ")
  )
)

pcas <- list(
  uncorrected = vst_raw,
  ruv = vst_ruv
) |>
  map(\(x) prcomp(t(x), scale. = FALSE, center = TRUE))

pca_scores <- pcas |>
  map(
    \(pca) as_tibble(pca$x, rownames = "sample_uid") |>
      power_inner_join(
        pca_meta,
        by = "sample_uid",
        check = check_specs(
          unmatched_keys_left = "warn",
          duplicate_keys_right = "warn"
        )
      )
  )

pc_variance <- pcas |>
  map(\(pca) set_names(pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2), colnames(pca$x)))
```

```{r plot-pca}
pca_pairs <- combn(paste0("PC", seq_len(5)), 2, simplify = FALSE)

make_pca_pairs <- function(scores, variance) {
  map(pca_pairs, function(pair) {
    axis_labels <- paste0(pair, " (", signif(variance[pair] * 100, 2), "%)")
    scores |>
      mutate(
        value_1 = .data[[pair[1]]],
        value_2 = .data[[pair[2]]],
        facet_label = paste(axis_labels, collapse = " vs ")
      ) |>
      select(-matches("^PC[0-9]+$"))
  }) |>
    bind_rows()
}

pca_x_vs <- map2(pca_scores, pc_variance, make_pca_pairs) |>
  bind_rows(.id = "correction")

pca_plots <- pca_x_vs |>
  group_nest(correction, keep = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    p = map2(
      data, correction,
      \(df, corr) ggplot(
        df,
        aes(
          x = value_1,
          y = value_2,
          color = condition_pca,
          shape = cell_line_batch
        )
      ) +
        geom_line(
          aes(group = pair_id),
          data = \(df) filter(df, !is.na(pair_id)),
          color = "black", linewidth = 0.3,
          show.legend = FALSE
        ) +
        geom_point(
          aes(
            text = paste0(
              "Sample: ", sample_uid, "<br>",
              "Cell line: ", Cell_line, "<br>",
              "Library prep batch: ", library_prep_batch, "<br>",
              "Timepoint: ", Timepoint
            )
          ),
          alpha = 0.8, size = 2, stroke = 0.8
        ) +
        scale_color_manual(
          values = pca_condition_colors,
          name = "Group"
        ) +
        scale_shape_manual(
          values = pca_shape_values,
          name = "Cell line | batch"
        ) +
        facet_wrap(~facet_label, scales = "free") +
        labs(
          x = NULL,
          y = NULL,
          title = corr
        ) +
        envalysis::theme_publish() +
        theme(
          legend.box = "vertical",
          strip.clip = "off"
        )
    )
  )

ggplotly(
  pca_plots$p[[match("ruv", pca_plots$correction)]],
  tooltip = c("text", "condition_pca", "cell_line_batch"),
  width = 1200, height = 1000
) |>
  htmlwidgets::saveWidget(
    file.path(plot_dir, "pca_vst_all_samples_ruv.html"),
    selfcontained = TRUE
  )

pwalk(
  pca_plots,
  \(correction, p, ...) ggsave(
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0("pca_vst_all_samples_", correction, ".pdf")),
    p, width = 14, height = 12
  )
)
```

## Gene expression overview

Plot VST expression of one or more genes (Ensembl IDs or gene symbols) across
all conditions. Sequencing batches are shown in separate panels because their
expression levels are not directly comparable.

```{r gene-expression}
plot_gene_expression <- function(genes, expr = vst_raw) {
  gene_ids <- gene_meta |>
    filter(gene_id %in% genes | gene_name %in% genes, gene_id %in% rownames(expr)) |>
    mutate(
      gene_label = coalesce(gene_name, gene_id),
      gene_label = if_else(
        duplicated(gene_label) | duplicated(gene_label, fromLast = TRUE),
        paste0(gene_label, " (", gene_id, ")"),
        gene_label
      )
    )
  if (nrow(gene_ids) == 0) {
    stop("None of the genes found: ", paste(genes, collapse = ", "))
  }

  df <- expr[gene_ids$gene_id, , drop = FALSE] |>
    as_tibble(rownames = "gene_id") |>
    pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "sample_uid", values_to = "expression") |>
    power_inner_join(
      gene_ids,
      by = "gene_id",
      check = check_specs(unmatched_keys_left = "warn")
    ) |>
    power_inner_join(
      pca_meta,
      by = "sample_uid",
      check = check_specs(unmatched_keys_left = "warn")
    ) |>
    mutate(
      Treatment = factor(
        Treatment,
        levels = c("DMSO", "Vemurafenib", "IFNg_50", "IFNg_100", "TNFa_100")
      ),
      library_prep_batch = factor(library_prep_batch)
    ) |>
    arrange(Cell_line, Group, Timepoint, Treatment, NGFRstatus) |>
    mutate(
      stage = paste(
        Cell_line, Group, Treatment, paste0("d", Timepoint), NGFRstatus,
        sep = " | "
      ) |>
        fct_inorder()
    )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = stage, y = expression, color = NGFRstatus)) +
    stat_summary(
      fun = median, geom = "crossbar", fun.min = median, fun.max = median,
      width = 0.6, linewidth = 0.3, color = "grey40"
    ) +
    geom_quasirandom(
      aes(shape = library_prep_batch),
      width = 0.2, size = 2
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(unsorted = "grey50", NGFRneg = "#6BAED6", NGFRpos = "#CB181D")
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c(`1` = 16, `2` = 17),
      name = "Library prep batch"
    ) +
    facet_grid(
      gene_label ~ sequencing_batch,
      scales = "free", space = "free_x"
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "VST expression") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
      panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "grey80")
    )
}

p <- plot_gene_expression(c("NGFR", "SOX10", "MITF"))
p

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "gene_expression_ngfr_sox10_mitf.pdf"),
  p, width = 12, height = 9
)
```

## Differential expression

The four models answer different questions. All use the same eligible genes.
`deseq_norm` above is used only for normalization, RUV estimation and QC.

| Model | Samples and technical replicates | Design | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deseq_all_ruv` | Both runs; technical replicates summed, with size-factor-weighted `W_1` | `~ W_1 + condition` | Standalone RUV diagnostics; not used downstream right now |
| `deseq_b2` | Batch 2, library prep batch 2 | `~ Treatment + inducer:NGFRpos` | Compare inducers, pooling the NGFR+ effect across IFNg doses |
| `deseq_b1` | Batch 1 only | `~ 0 + condition` | Compare NGFR states across cell lines |
| `deseq_all` | Both runs; resequenced batch 2 libraries excluded | `~ 0 + condition` | Compare d7 and acute drug responses with shared dispersion estimation |

### Shared analysis helpers

```{r analysis-helpers}
extract_deseq_result <- function(de, contrast, res_args = list()) {
  res <- rlang::exec(results, de, contrast = contrast, !!!res_args)
  lfcShrink(de, res = res, type = "ashr") |>
    as_tibble(rownames = "gene_id") |>
    left_join(
      res |>
        as_tibble(rownames = "gene_id") |>
        select(gene_id, log2FoldChange, lfcSE),
      by = "gene_id", suffix = c("", "_MLE")
    )
}

run_contrasts <- function(de, contrasts, gene_meta) {
  contrasts |>
    mutate(
      res = map2(
        contrast, res_args,
        \(contrast, res_args) extract_deseq_result(de, contrast, res_args)
      )
    ) |>
    select(-contrast, -res_args) |>
    unnest(res) |>
    power_left_join(
      gene_meta,
      by = "gene_id",
      check = check_specs(
        unmatched_keys_left = "warn",
        duplicate_keys_right = "warn"
      )
    ) |>
    mutate(gene_label = coalesce(gene_name, gene_id))
}

summarize_de <- function(res, effect = log2FoldChange) {
  res |>
    group_by(contrast_name) |>
    summarise(
      n_sig = sum(padj < .05, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_up = sum(padj < .05 & {{ effect }} > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_down = sum(padj < .05 & {{ effect }} < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

shared_signature <- function(res) {
  res |>
    group_by(gene_id, gene_label) |>
    summarize(
      log2FoldChange_min = sign(log2FoldChange[1]) * min(abs(log2FoldChange)),
      same_direction = n_distinct(sign(log2FoldChange)) == 1,
      n_contrasts_sig = sum(coalesce(padj, 1) < .05),
      pvalue = if_else(same_direction, max(pvalue), 1),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(padj = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH")) |>
    arrange(padj)
}

plot_volcano <- function(res, n_labels = 10) {
  res |>
    mutate(contrast_name = fct_inorder(contrast_name)) |>
    ggplot(aes(log2FoldChange, -log10(padj))) +
    rasterize(
      geom_point(aes(color = padj < .05), shape = 16, alpha = .5),
      dpi = 300, device = "ragg_png"
    ) +
    geom_text_repel(
      aes(label = gene_label),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      data = \(df) group_by(df, contrast_name, log2FoldChange > 0) |>
        arrange(padj, pvalue) |>
        slice_head(n = n_labels)
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "black", `TRUE` = "red")) +
    facet_wrap(~contrast_name, scales = "free")
}
```

### All samples with RUV adjustment

Merge technical replicates from the two sequencing runs, using their
size-factor-weighted mean `W_1`. The results below are standalone diagnostics;
subsequent analyses use `deseq_b1`, `deseq_b2`, or `deseq_all`.

```{r fit-all-ruv}
deseq_meta |> count(condition)

de_contrasts_all_ruv <- tribble(
  ~contrast_id, ~contrast_name, ~condition_numerator, ~condition_denominator,
  "acute", "Acute A375 Vemurafenib vs DMSO", "A375_Acute_unsorted_Vemurafenib_d3", "A375_Acute_unsorted_DMSO_d3",
  "ngfr_vemu_d7", "FACS A375 NGFR+ vs NGFR- Vemurafenib d7", "A375_FACS_NGFRpos_Vemurafenib_d7", "A375_FACS_NGFRneg_Vemurafenib_d7",
  "A375", "FACS A375 NGFR+ vs NGFR- Vemurafenib d14", "A375_FACS_NGFRpos_Vemurafenib_d14", "A375_FACS_NGFRneg_Vemurafenib_d14",
  "ngfr_ifng_50", "FACS A375 IFNg 50 NGFR+ vs NGFR-", "A375_FACS_NGFRpos_IFNg_50_d7", "A375_FACS_NGFRneg_IFNg_50_d7",
  "ngfr_ifng_100", "FACS A375 IFNg 100 NGFR+ vs NGFR-", "A375_FACS_NGFRpos_IFNg_100_d7", "A375_FACS_NGFRneg_IFNg_100_d7",
  "A375_SingleClone", "SingleClone A375 NGFR+ vs NGFR- Vemurafenib d14", "A375_SingleClone_NGFRpos_Vemurafenib_d14", "A375_SingleClone_NGFRneg_Vemurafenib_d14",
  "COLO858", "FACS COLO858 NGFR+ vs NGFR- Vemurafenib d14", "COLO858_FACS_NGFRpos_Vemurafenib_d14", "COLO858_FACS_NGFRneg_Vemurafenib_d14",
  "WM115", "FACS WM115 NGFR+ vs NGFR- Vemurafenib d14", "WM115_FACS_NGFRpos_Vemurafenib_d14", "WM115_FACS_NGFRneg_Vemurafenib_d14",
  "ngfrneg_vemu_dmso", "FACS A375 NGFR- Vemurafenib vs DMSO d7", "A375_FACS_NGFRneg_Vemurafenib_d7", "A375_FACS_NGFRneg_DMSO_d7",
  "ngfrpos_vemu_ifng50", "FACS A375 NGFR+ Vemurafenib vs IFNg 50 d14", "A375_FACS_NGFRpos_Vemurafenib_d14", "A375_FACS_NGFRpos_IFNg_50_d7",
  "ngfrpos_vemu_ifng100", "FACS A375 NGFR+ Vemurafenib vs IFNg 100 d14", "A375_FACS_NGFRpos_Vemurafenib_d14", "A375_FACS_NGFRpos_IFNg_100_d7",
) |>
  mutate(
    contrast = map2(
      condition_numerator, condition_denominator,
      \(num, den) c("condition", num, den)
    ),
    res_args = list(list())
  )

deseq_all_ruv <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_mat[genes_eligible, deseq_meta$sample_uid] |>
    round(),
  colData = deseq_meta |>
    group_by(merged_id) |>
    mutate(
      W_1 = weighted.mean(W_1, size_factor)
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    column_to_rownames("sample_uid"),
  design = ~ W_1 + condition
) |>
  collapseReplicates(
    groupby = deseq_meta$merged_id
  ) |>
  DESeq()

deseq_res_all_ruv <- run_contrasts(deseq_all_ruv, de_contrasts_all_ruv, gene_meta)
```

```{r summarize-all-ruv}
summarize_de(deseq_res_all_ruv)
```

```{r volcano-all-ruv}
p <- plot_volcano(deseq_res_all_ruv)

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "de_volcanos.pdf"),
  p, width = 14, height = 10
)
```

## Inducer comparison within batch 2

All d7 inducer samples (DMSO, Vemurafenib, IFNg, TNFa) are together in batch 2,
analyzed separately.

There are no NGFR+ samples for DMSO and TNFa, so NGFR+ vs NGFR- is
estimated only for Vemurafenib and IFNg. We use a main effect per treatment
(describing NGFR- cells) plus an NGFR+ effect per inducer, pooling the two
IFNg doses because IFNg 50 only has a single replicate.

```{r fit-batch-2}
meta_b2 <- deseq_meta |>
  filter(sequencing_batch == "batch_2", library_prep_batch == 2) |>
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(
      Treatment,
      levels = c("DMSO", "Vemurafenib", "IFNg_50", "IFNg_100", "TNFa_100")
    ),
    inducer = str_remove(Treatment, "_[0-9]+$"),
    NGFRpos = as.numeric(NGFRstatus == "NGFRpos")
  )

meta_b2 |>
  count(Treatment, inducer, NGFRstatus)

design_b2 <- model.matrix(
  ~ Treatment + inducer:NGFRpos,
  data = meta_b2
)
design_b2 <- design_b2[, colSums(design_b2 != 0) > 0]
colnames(design_b2) <- colnames(design_b2) |>
  str_remove_all("[()]") |>
  str_replace_all(":", "_")

deseq_b2 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_mat[genes_eligible, meta_b2$sample_uid] |>
    round(),
  colData = meta_b2 |>
    column_to_rownames("sample_uid"),
  design = design_b2
) |>
  DESeq()

resultsNames(deseq_b2)
```

Contrasts in terms of the model coefficients. Treatment contrasts describe
NGFR- cells, NGFR+ states are the treatment coefficient plus the inducer's
NGFR+ coefficient.

```{r contrasts-batch-2}
coef_vemu <- "TreatmentVemurafenib"
coef_ifng_50 <- "TreatmentIFNg_50"
coef_ifng <- "TreatmentIFNg_100"
coef_tnfa <- "TreatmentTNFa_100"
coef_ngfr_vemu <- "inducerVemurafenib_NGFRpos"
coef_ngfr_ifng <- "inducerIFNg_NGFRpos"

de_contrasts_b2 <- tribble(
  ~contrast_id, ~contrast_name, ~contrast, ~res_args,
  # NGFR+ vs NGFR-
  "ngfr_vemu", "NGFR+ vs NGFR- | Vemurafenib", list(coef_ngfr_vemu), list(),
  "ngfr_ifng", "NGFR+ vs NGFR- | IFNg", list(coef_ngfr_ifng), list(),
  "ngfr_mean", "NGFR+ vs NGFR- | mean Vemurafenib & IFNg", list(c(coef_ngfr_vemu, coef_ngfr_ifng), character()), list(listValues = c(0.5, -0.5)),
  "ngfr_ifng_vs_vemu", "NGFR+ vs NGFR- | IFNg vs Vemurafenib", list(coef_ngfr_ifng, coef_ngfr_vemu), list(),
  # Inducers within NGFR-
  "neg_vemu_dmso", "NGFR- | Vemurafenib vs DMSO", list(coef_vemu), list(),
  "neg_ifng50_dmso", "NGFR- | IFNg 50 vs DMSO", list(coef_ifng_50), list(),
  "neg_ifng100_dmso", "NGFR- | IFNg 100 vs DMSO", list(coef_ifng), list(),
  "neg_tnfa_dmso", "NGFR- | TNFa vs DMSO", list(coef_tnfa), list(),
  "neg_ifng100_vemu", "NGFR- | IFNg 100 vs Vemurafenib", list(coef_ifng, coef_vemu), list(),
  "neg_tnfa_vemu", "NGFR- | TNFa vs Vemurafenib", list(coef_tnfa, coef_vemu), list(),
  "neg_tnfa_ifng100", "NGFR- | TNFa vs IFNg 100", list(coef_tnfa, coef_ifng), list(),
  # Inducers within NGFR+
  "pos_ifng100_vemu", "NGFR+ | IFNg 100 vs Vemurafenib", list(c(coef_ifng, coef_ngfr_ifng), c(coef_vemu, coef_ngfr_vemu)), list(),
  # NGFR+ states vs untreated NGFR- cells
  "pos_vemu_neg_dmso", "NGFR+ Vemurafenib vs NGFR- DMSO", list(c(coef_vemu, coef_ngfr_vemu)), list(),
  "pos_ifng100_neg_dmso", "NGFR+ IFNg 100 vs NGFR- DMSO", list(c(coef_ifng, coef_ngfr_ifng)), list()
)

deseq_res_b2 <- run_contrasts(deseq_b2, de_contrasts_b2, gene_meta)
```

Genes with a shared NGFR+ signature, i.e. changed in the same direction in both
Vemurafenib and IFNg (intersection-union test, maximum of the two p-values).

### Design check: pooled IFNg doses for the main effect

Quick comparison of the current design (per dose main effect, pooled IFNg
NGFR+ effect) against pooling the IFNg doses for the main effect too
(`~ inducer + inducer:NGFRpos`).

```{r design-comparison-b2}
meta_b2_alt <- meta_b2 |>
  mutate(
    inducer = factor(inducer, levels = c("DMSO", "Vemurafenib", "IFNg", "TNFa"))
  )

design_b2_alt <- model.matrix(
  ~ inducer + inducer:NGFRpos,
  data = meta_b2_alt
)
design_b2_alt <- design_b2_alt[, colSums(design_b2_alt != 0) > 0]
colnames(design_b2_alt) <- colnames(design_b2_alt) |>
  str_remove_all("[()]") |>
  str_replace_all(":", "_")

deseq_b2_alt <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_mat[genes_eligible, meta_b2_alt$sample_uid] |>
    round(),
  colData = meta_b2_alt |>
    column_to_rownames("sample_uid"),
  design = design_b2_alt
) |>
  DESeq()

resultsNames(deseq_b2_alt)

design_cmp_res <- list(current = deseq_b2, pooled = deseq_b2_alt) |>
  imap(\(de, design) {
    c(coef_ngfr_vemu, coef_ngfr_ifng) |>
      set_names() |>
      map(\(coef) results(de, name = coef) |> as_tibble(rownames = "gene_id")) |>
      list_rbind(names_to = "coef") |>
      mutate(design = design)
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

# DE counts per design
design_cmp_res |>
  group_by(design, coef) |>
  summarize(
    n_sig = sum(padj < .05, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_up = sum(padj < .05 & log2FoldChange > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_down = sum(padj < .05 & log2FoldChange < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

design_cmp_wide <- design_cmp_res |>
  select(design, coef, gene_id, log2FoldChange, pvalue, padj) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = design, values_from = c(log2FoldChange, pvalue, padj)) |>
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      padj_current < .05 & padj_pooled < .05 ~ "both",
      padj_current < .05 ~ "current only",
      padj_pooled < .05 ~ "pooled only",
      TRUE ~ "neither"
    )
  )

design_cmp_wide |>
  count(coef, sig) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = sig, values_from = n)

design_cmp_wide |>
  group_by(coef) |>
  summarize(
    cor_lfc = cor(log2FoldChange_current, log2FoldChange_pooled, use = "complete.obs"),
    cor_log_p = cor(-log10(pvalue_current), -log10(pvalue_pooled), use = "complete.obs"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p <- design_cmp_wide |>
  ggplot(aes(log2FoldChange_current, log2FoldChange_pooled, color = sig)) +
  rasterize(
    geom_point(shape = 16, alpha = .4, size = .8),
    dpi = 300, device = "ragg_png"
  ) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~coef) +
  labs(x = "log2FC current design", y = "log2FC pooled IFNg design")

p_p <- design_cmp_wide |>
  ggplot(aes(-log10(pvalue_current), -log10(pvalue_pooled), color = sig)) +
  rasterize(
    geom_point(shape = 16, alpha = .4, size = .8),
    dpi = 300, device = "ragg_png"
  ) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~coef) +
  labs(x = "-log10 p current design", y = "-log10 p pooled IFNg design")

# Dispersion differences, expected to be inflated in the pooled design for
# genes with an IFNg dose effect
p_disp <- tibble(
  gene_id = rownames(deseq_b2),
  disp_current = dispersions(deseq_b2),
  disp_pooled = dispersions(deseq_b2_alt)
) |>
  left_join(
    results(deseq_b2, contrast = list(coef_ifng, coef_ifng_50)) |>
      as_tibble(rownames = "gene_id") |>
      select(gene_id, lfc_ifng_dose = log2FoldChange),
    by = "gene_id"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(log2(disp_current), log2(disp_pooled), color = abs(lfc_ifng_dose))) +
  rasterize(
    geom_point(shape = 16, alpha = .5, size = .8),
    dpi = 300, device = "ragg_png"
  ) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 2), oob = scales::squish) +
  labs(color = "|log2FC|\nIFNg 100 vs 50")

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "design_comparison_batch_2.pdf"),
  patchwork::wrap_plots(p, p_p, p_disp, ncol = 1),
  width = 9, height = 13
)
```

### Comparing effects between inducers and batches

Use `deseq_b2` for the inducer contrasts and `deseq_b1` for the A375 d14
NGFR+ vs NGFR- contrast. Compare within-batch fold changes across the two runs.

```{r compare-inducers}
plot_lfc_scatter <- function(res, x_contrast, y_contrast) {
  contrast_labels <- res |>
    distinct(contrast_id, contrast_name) |>
    deframe()
  df <- res |>
    filter(contrast_id %in% c(x_contrast, y_contrast)) |>
    transmute(
      gene_id, gene_label,
      contrast = if_else(contrast_id == x_contrast, "x", "y"),
      log2FoldChange, padj
    ) |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = contrast,
      values_from = c(log2FoldChange, padj)
    ) |>
    mutate(
      significant = case_when(
        padj_x < .05 & padj_y < .05 ~ "both",
        padj_x < .05 ~ "x only",
        padj_y < .05 ~ "y only",
        TRUE ~ "none"
      ) |>
        factor(levels = c("none", "x only", "y only", "both"))
    ) |>
    arrange(significant)
  lfc_cor <- cor(df$log2FoldChange_x, df$log2FoldChange_y, use = "complete.obs")
  ggplot(df, aes(log2FoldChange_x, log2FoldChange_y)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
    rasterize(
      geom_point(aes(color = significant), shape = 16, alpha = .6),
      dpi = 300, device = "ragg_png"
    ) +
    geom_text_repel(
      aes(label = gene_label),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      data = \(df) filter(df, significant == "both") |>
        slice_max(abs(log2FoldChange_x) + abs(log2FoldChange_y), n = 20)
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(none = "grey80", `x only` = "#2171B5", `y only` = "#1b9173", both = "#CB181D")
    ) +
    labs(
      x = contrast_labels[[x_contrast]], y = contrast_labels[[y_contrast]],
      title = paste0("Pearson r = ", signif(lfc_cor, 2))
    )
}

lfc_comparisons <- tribble(
  ~x_contrast, ~y_contrast,
  "ngfr_vemu", "ngfr_ifng",
  "pos_vemu_neg_dmso", "pos_ifng100_neg_dmso",
  "neg_vemu_dmso", "neg_ifng100_dmso",
  "neg_vemu_dmso", "neg_tnfa_dmso",
  "neg_ifng100_dmso", "neg_tnfa_dmso",
  "A375", "ngfr_vemu"
)

res_combined <- bind_rows(
  deseq_res_b1 |>
    select(contrast_id, contrast_name, gene_id, gene_label, log2FoldChange, padj),
  deseq_res_b2 |>
    select(contrast_id, contrast_name, gene_id, gene_label, log2FoldChange, padj)
)

p <- lfc_comparisons |>
  pmap(\(x_contrast, y_contrast) plot_lfc_scatter(res_combined, x_contrast, y_contrast)) |>
  patchwork::wrap_plots(ncol = 2, guides = "collect")

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "de_lfc_comparisons_batch_2.pdf"),
  p, width = 14, height = 18
)
```

## NGFR- Vemurafenib vs DMSO removing Vemu effect

The d7 contrast NGFR- Vemurafenib vs NGFR- DMSO mixes the direct
pharmacological response to BRAF inhibition with what is specific to the NGFR-
cells persisting under Vemurafenib. The acute A375 Vemurafenib vs DMSO d3
samples (batch 1, unsorted) serve as reference for the drug response. Only fold
changes are compared across batches, so additive batch effects should cancel.

The d7 DMSO baseline is also FACS sorted, that sorting effect should
cancel too.

The acute samples are d3, unsorted and from a different experiment and
library prep, so differences to the acute response also include d3 to d7
adaptation.

### Difference-in-differences

Joint model of all libraries (re-sequenced libraries only counted once).
Conditions are nested within batch, so batch is absorbed by the
condition term.

We assume here that the drug signature has the same magnitude at d3 and d7.

```{r fit-all}
meta_joint <- deseq_meta |>
  filter(!(sequencing_batch == "batch_2" & library_prep_batch == 1))

deseq_all <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_mat[genes_eligible, meta_joint$sample_uid] |>
    round(),
  colData = meta_joint |>
    column_to_rownames("sample_uid"),
  design = ~ 0 + condition
) |>
  DESeq()

coef_neg_vemu_d7 <- "conditionA375_FACS_NGFRneg_Vemurafenib_d7"
coef_neg_dmso_d7 <- "conditionA375_FACS_NGFRneg_DMSO_d7"
coef_acute_vemu <- "conditionA375_Acute_unsorted_Vemurafenib_d3"
coef_acute_dmso <- "conditionA375_Acute_unsorted_DMSO_d3"

de_contrasts_all <- tribble(
  ~contrast_id, ~contrast_name, ~contrast,
  "vemu_d7", "NGFR- Vemurafenib vs DMSO d7", list(coef_neg_vemu_d7, coef_neg_dmso_d7),
  "vemu_acute", "Acute Vemurafenib vs DMSO d3", list(coef_acute_vemu, coef_acute_dmso),
  "vemu_did", "NGFR- Vemurafenib d7 effect - acute Vemurafenib effect", list(c(coef_neg_vemu_d7, coef_acute_dmso), c(coef_neg_dmso_d7, coef_acute_vemu))
) |>
  mutate(res_args = list(list()))

deseq_res_all <- run_contrasts(deseq_all, de_contrasts_all, gene_meta)

summarize_de(deseq_res_all)

write_csv(
  deseq_res_all,
  file.path(plot_dir, "de_a375_ngfrneg_d7_vemu_effect_minus_acute_d3_vemu_effect_long.csv.gz")
)
```

The joint model pools dispersions across batches. The d7 contrast should agree
with the batch 2 only model.

```{r validate-d7-effect}
deseq_res_all |>
  filter(contrast_id == "vemu_d7") |>
  inner_join(
    deseq_res_b2 |>
      filter(contrast_id == "neg_vemu_dmso"),
    by = "gene_id", suffix = c("_joint", "_b2")
  ) |>
  summarise(
    lfc_cor = cor(log2FoldChange_joint, log2FoldChange_b2, use = "complete.obs"),
    n_sig_joint = sum(padj_joint < .05, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sig_b2 = sum(padj_b2 < .05, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sig_both = sum(padj_joint < .05 & padj_b2 < .05, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

1   0.971        2658     3634       2445

Compare the per-cell-line fold changes from `deseq_b1` with the joint
model `deseq_all`, which uses no RUV adjustment.

```{r validate-cell-line-effects}
deseq_res_all_cell_lines <- run_contrasts(
  deseq_all,
  de_contrasts_b1 |> filter(contrast_id %in% ngfr_cell_lines),
  gene_meta
)

deseq_res_b1 |>
  filter(contrast_id %in% ngfr_cell_lines) |>
  inner_join(
    deseq_res_all_cell_lines |>
      select(contrast_id, gene_id, log2FoldChange, padj),
    by = c("contrast_id", "gene_id"), suffix = c("_b1", "_all")
  ) |>
  group_by(contrast_id) |>
  summarise(
    lfc_cor = cor(log2FoldChange_b1, log2FoldChange_all, use = "complete.obs"),
    n_sig_b1 = sum(padj_b1 < .05, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sig_all = sum(padj_all < .05, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

### Classifying genes by drug response pattern

Regressing the d7 fold changes on the acute ones does not work well. Across
genes the slope is only ~0.4 and acute fold changes explain only 25-40% of the
d7 variance: some genes keep the full acute response at d7 (e.g. DCT, SPRY4)
while many acute responders are back to baseline. A single scaling factor of
the drug signature therefore doesn't describe the data. Instead, genes are
classified using the d7 and acute contrasts and the difference-in-differences:

- persistent drug response: changed in both, same direction, no significant
  difference between them
- persistent, different magnitude: changed in both, same direction, but
  significantly stronger or weaker at d7
- NGFR- d7 specific: changed at d7 but not acutely (|acute log2FC| < 0.5),
  significant difference-in-differences. These are the candidates for what
  distinguishes NGFR- Vemurafenib persisters beyond the drug response.
- acute only: changed acutely but not at d7, significant
  difference-in-differences (transient drug response)
- opposite: changed in both in opposite directions

NGFR+ vs NGFR- (Vemurafenib) fold changes at d7 (batch 2 model) and d14
(joint model, batch 1 samples), used below to relate the classes to the NGFR+
state.

```{r ngfr-axes}
ngfr_axes <- bind_rows(
  d7 = deseq_res_b2 |>
    filter(contrast_id == "ngfr_vemu") |>
    select(gene_id, log2FoldChange),
  d14 = extract_deseq_result(
    deseq_all,
    contrast = c(
      "condition",
      "A375_FACS_NGFRpos_Vemurafenib_d14",
      "A375_FACS_NGFRneg_Vemurafenib_d14"
    )
  ) |>
    select(gene_id, log2FoldChange),
  .id = "timepoint"
) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = timepoint,
    values_from = log2FoldChange,
    names_prefix = "log2FoldChange_ngfr_axis_"
  )
```

```{r classify-drug-response}
drug_response_classes <- deseq_res_all |>
  filter(contrast_id %in% c("vemu_d7", "vemu_acute", "vemu_did")) |>
  select(gene_id, gene_label, contrast_id, log2FoldChange, padj) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = contrast_id,
    values_from = c(log2FoldChange, padj)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("padj_"), \(x) coalesce(x, 1)),
    sig_d7 = padj_vemu_d7 < .05,
    sig_acute = padj_vemu_acute < .05,
    sig_did = padj_vemu_did < .05,
    response_class = case_when(
      sig_d7 & sig_acute & sign(log2FoldChange_vemu_d7) != sign(log2FoldChange_vemu_acute) ~ "opposite",
      sig_d7 & sig_acute & !sig_did ~ "persistent drug response",
      sig_d7 & sig_acute & sig_did ~ "persistent, different magnitude",
      sig_d7 & !sig_acute & abs(log2FoldChange_vemu_acute) < 0.5 & sig_did ~ "NGFR- d7 specific",
      sig_acute & !sig_d7 & sig_did ~ "acute only",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ) |>
      factor(
        levels = c(
          "persistent drug response", "persistent, different magnitude",
          "NGFR- d7 specific", "acute only",
          "opposite", "other"
        )
      )
  ) |>
  power_left_join(
    ngfr_axes,
    by = "gene_id",
    check = check_specs(
      unmatched_keys_left = "warn",
      duplicate_keys_right = "warn"
    )
  )

drug_response_classes |>
  count(response_class, direction_d7 = sign(log2FoldChange_vemu_d7))

drug_response_classes |>
  filter(response_class == "NGFR- d7 specific") |>
  arrange(padj_vemu_did) |>
  select(gene_label, log2FoldChange_vemu_d7, log2FoldChange_vemu_acute, padj_vemu_d7, padj_vemu_did, starts_with("log2FoldChange_ngfr_axis"))

write_csv(
  drug_response_classes,
  file.path(plot_dir, "a375_ngfrneg_d7_vemu_response_classes_vs_acute_d3.csv.gz")
)
```

Are the NGFR- d7 specific changes related to the NGFR+ vs NGFR- axis? A
negative correlation means the d7 specific changes go in the opposite
direction to NGFR+ cells, i.e. NGFR- persisters become more "NGFR-like".

The d7 axis (NGFR+ Vemurafenib - NGFR- Vemurafenib) shares the NGFR-
Vemurafenib samples with the d7 contrast (NGFR- Vemurafenib - DMSO) with
opposite sign, so noise in these samples alone produces a negative correlation.
The d14 axis comes from independent samples (batch 1) and is not affected.

```{r summarize-drug-response}
drug_response_classes |>
  group_by(response_class) |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    across(
      starts_with("log2FoldChange_ngfr_axis_"),
      \(x) cor(log2FoldChange_vemu_d7, x, use = "complete.obs"),
      .names = "cor_with_{str_remove(.col, 'log2FoldChange_')}"
    )
  )
```

```{r plot-drug-response}
p <- drug_response_classes |>
  arrange(desc(response_class)) |>
  ggplot(aes(log2FoldChange_vemu_acute, log2FoldChange_vemu_d7)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "grey70", linetype = "dashed") +
  rasterize(
    geom_point(aes(color = response_class), shape = 16, alpha = .6),
    dpi = 300, device = "ragg_png"
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = gene_label),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    data = \(df) filter(df, response_class == "NGFR- d7 specific") |>
      group_by(log2FoldChange_vemu_d7 > 0) |>
      slice_min(padj_vemu_did, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      `persistent drug response` = "#2171B5",
      `persistent, different magnitude` = "#9ECAE1",
      `NGFR- d7 specific` = "#CB181D",
      `acute only` = "#f0be19",
      opposite = "#1b9173",
      other = "grey85"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Acute Vemurafenib vs DMSO d3 (log2FC)",
    y = "NGFR- Vemurafenib vs DMSO d7 (log2FC)",
    title = "Labelled: top NGFR- d7 specific genes"
  )
p

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "lfc_ngfrneg_vemu_vs_acute_classes.pdf"),
  p, width = 10, height = 8
)
```

### MAPK pathway activity genes

MPAS genes (Wagle et al. 2018) as readout of MAPK pathway suppression. If they
are still suppressed at d7, the acute signature is a reasonable reference for
the drug response and these genes should be classified as persistent drug
response.

```{r mapk-genes}
mpas_genes <- c(
  "PHLDA1", "SPRY2", "SPRY4", "DUSP4", "DUSP6",
  "CCND1", "EPHA2", "EPHA4", "ETV4", "ETV5"
)

drug_response_classes |>
  filter(gene_label %in% mpas_genes) |>
  select(
    gene_label, response_class, log2FoldChange_d7, log2FoldChange_acute,
    log2FoldChange_did, padj_d7, padj_acute, padj_did
  )

p <- plot_gene_expression(mpas_genes)

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "gene_expression_mpas.pdf"),
  p, width = 12, height = 20
)
```
